name: Icpc2DanishTranslations
title: International Classification of Primary Care, second edition (1998), danish translation
description: Danish-language designation supplement for the International Classification of Primary Care, second edition (ICPC-2). Provides Danish labels for 686 symptom and diagnosis codes in http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icpc-2. Process codes and Danish-only grouping codes are not included. The authoritative source for the Danish labels is KiAP ICPC-2-DK version 4.4, [ICPC_v4_4_20260629.accdb](https://web.kiap.dk/resources/files/icpc/systemhuse/ICPC_v4_4_20260629.accdb), table ICPCKON2-v4_4_20260501, fields ICPC-kode and ICPC-diagnose. Whitespace is normalized. Where source rows contain conflicting labels for the same code, this supplement uses Demens for P70, Infektion i luftveje IKA for R83, and Insektstik for S12. KiAP maintains the Danish ICPC-2-DK classification; see [Diagnosekodning ICPC-2](https://www.kiap.dk/praksis/icpc-2). The version identifies publication of this supplement, not a release of the underlying classification.
